title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
**Regional Sales Manager – Telangana**

**Company:** Greenwell Healthcare  
**Location:** – Telangana All Districts  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Healthcare / Medical Devices

**About Greenwell Healthcare**

Greenwell Healthcare is a growing healthcare company specializing in **Sleep \& Respiratory Care solutions**, including CPAP, BiPAP, Oxygen Concentrators and related medical equipment. We are expanding our presence across Telangana and are looking for an experienced sales professional to build and lead our distribution network.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a **Regional Sales Manager – Telangana** with strong channel\-sales experience to develop Greenwell Healthcare's **dealer and sub\-dealer network across all districts of Telangana**

The primary responsibility will be to **identify, appoint, activate and develop dealers and sub\-dealers**, while driving sales and expanding Greenwell's market presence throughout Telangana

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and appoint dealers and sub\-dealers across all districts of Telangana.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with the dealer network.
* Achieve dealer appointment, sales and territory development targets.
* Generate new business opportunities and expand market coverage.
* Drive primary and secondary sales through dealers.
* Conduct regular dealer visits, meetings and product presentations.
* Train and support dealers on products and applications.
* Monitor competitor activities, pricing and market trends.
* Coordinate with Sales, Service and Operations teams for dealer support.
* Ensure timely collections and adherence to company commercial policies.
* Maintain dealer database, sales pipeline and regular MIS reports.

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate / MBA in Sales \& Marketing preferred.
* **4–8 years of experience** in medical equipment, healthcare, pharma , FMCG, Electronics or related channel sales.
* Proven experience in **dealer/distributor appointment and channel development**.
* Strong understanding of the Tamilnadu market and distribution network.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship\-management skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across Telangana
* Existing network of medical equipment / healthcare dealers and channels will be an advantage.

**Compensation \& Incentives**

* **Attractive fixed salary** based on experience and capabilities.
* **Highly attractive performance\-based incentives in addition to the fixed salary.**
* Incentives linked to **dealer appointments, dealer activation, sales and territory growth**.
* **Excellent earning potential** for candidates who successfully build and grow the Telangana network.

**Why Join Greenwell Healthcare?**

This is an opportunity to **build the Telangana distribution network from the ground up** and play a key role in Greenwell Healthcare's expansion.

If you are a result\-oriented sales professional with strong channel\-building skills and the ambition to create a high\-performing dealer network, **we would like to hear from you.**

**Greenwell Healthcare – Building Better Access to Sleep \& Respiratory Care.**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sales Manager
description:
Area Sales Manager (ASM)  
SUMMARY

The Area Sales Manager (ASM) is responsible for driving sales and business growth within the assigned territory for jewellery packing materials, packaging solutions, and related products. The role involves developing new business, managing existing customer relationships, achieving sales targets, and coordinating with production, planning, and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Strong sales and negotiation skills.

Excellent communication and presentation abilities. Customer relationship management.

Territory planning and market analysis.

Knowledge of CRM and MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Ability to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.

DEPARTMENT

Sales \& Business Development

REPORTS TO

Territory Sales Manager/TSM – Sales

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Sales \& Business Development \- Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. \- Identify and acquire new customers, including jewellery manufacturers, exporters, wholesalers, and retailers. \- Maintain strong relationships with existing customers to maximize repeat business. \- Conduct regular customer visits to understand requirements and propose suitable packaging solutions. \- Generate enquiries, prepare quotations, negotiate prices, and close orders.

Customer Relationship Management \- Act as the primary point of contact for customers in the assigned territory. \- Resolve customer complaints and coordinate with internal departments for timely resolution. \- Ensure high customer satisfaction through consistent service and support.

Market Development \- Monitor competitor activities, pricing, and market trends. \- Identify new business opportunities, market segments, and distribution channels. \- Participate in trade exhibitions, customer meetings, and promotional activities.

Coordination \- Coordinate with Production, Planning, Quality, and Dispatch teams to ensure timely order execution. \- Monitor order status and communicate delivery schedules to customers. \- Ensure smooth payment collections as per company policy.

Reporting \& Administration \- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports. \- Maintain accurate records of customer visits, enquiries, quotations, orders, and collections. \- Forecast sales and submit territory performance reports to management.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

\- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field. \- MBA (Marketing) is preferred.

EXPERIENCE

\- 3–7 years of B2B sales experience in jewellery packaging, packaging materials, printing, industrial products, or related manufacturing industries. \- Proven track record of achieving sales targets.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)

\- Achievement of sales revenue and volume targets. \- New customer acquisition. \- Customer retention rate. \- Collection efficiency and outstanding receivables. \- Territory growth and market share. \- On\-time order fulfillment and customer satisfaction. \- Sales forecast accuracy.

PREFERRED INDUSTRY EXPOSURE

\- Jewellery packaging manufacturers \- Packaging materials industry \- Printing and labelling solutions \- Luxury product packaging \- B2B industrial sales

WORKING CONDITIONS

\- Frequent travel within the assigned territory. \- Regular customer meetings, Showroom visits, and participation in exhibitions. \- Performance\-based incentives linked to sales achievement.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* B2B sales: 3 years (Required)
